evidence.notes: Local Canvas lifecycle handlers return an empty excluded context type set by default.
Local Canvas lifecycle handlers accept the mocked RenderContext.
Canvas render exceptions expose their platform type name.
The local test harness builds a Canvas.RenderContext from application and environment maps.
The local test harness dispatches the lifecycle handler with the supplied RenderContext.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeCanvasLocalEvidenceTest { @isTest static void exercisesLocalCanvasLifecycle() { Map<String,String> app = new Map<String,String>(); app.put('canvasUrl', 'https://canvas.example'); app.put('name', 'Local Canvas'); Map<String,String> env = new Map<String,String>(); env.put('displayLocation', 'Visualforce'); env.put('locationUrl', '/apex/Host'); Canvas.RenderContext ctx = Canvas.Test.mockRenderContext(app, env); System.assertEquals('https://canvas.example', ctx.getApplicationContext().getCanvasUrl()); System.assertEquals('Local Canvas', ctx.getApplicationContext().getName()); System.assertEquals('Visualforce', ctx.getEnvironmentContext().getDisplayLocation()); System.assertEquals('/apex/Host', ctx.getEnvironmentContext().getLocationUrl()); Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler handler = new Canvas.CanvasLifecycleHandler(); System.assertEquals(0, handler.excludeContextTypes().size()); handler.onRender(ctx); Canvas.Test.testCanvasLifecycle(handler, ctx); Canvas.CanvasRenderException ex = new Canvas.CanvasRenderException('render failed'); System.assertEquals('Canvas.CanvasRenderException', ex.getTypeName()); } }
